description_en: Queries the analysis template of a smart tagging job
description_zh: 查询智能标签作业的分析模板
name: QuerySmarttagTemplateList

parameters.help_en: The ID of the template. You can obtain the template ID from the response of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/187759.html operation. If you set this parameter to a specific value, the information about the corresponding template is returned. If you do not specify this parameter, the operation returns the information about all the templates that are created by the current RAM user
parameters.help_zh: 模板ID，可以从https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/187759.html的返回参数中获取。若指定该参数，则只返回该模板的信息；否则返回当前RAM⽤户所有模板的信息
parameters.name: template_id
